device_name: CAPSTONE PEEK TLIF & PLIF Interbody Spacer
description: The CAPSTONE PEEK spacer by Medtronic is intended for use either unilaterally  obliquely or bilaterally in the PLIF procedure for interbody stabilization. It features a 10mm width spacer anatomically designed for easier implantation and contour to the endplate.
features: Radiolucent PEEK design with teeth on surface to prevent expulsion
Can be placed MIS using MIS inserters
